business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial Soundscape Licensing and Audio Sample Subscriptions

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (national unitary jurisdiction; no separate sub-state incorporation registries)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic, Napoleonic codification; special S.A.S. regime under Law 1258 of 2008)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force May 15, 2012; investment chapter with ISDS)
Colombia–European Union–Peru Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since August 2013; investment chapter)
DTAAs in force: Spain (2008), Chile (2009), Switzerland (2012), Mexico (2013), India (2014), United Kingdom (2016), Korea (2017), France (2017), Japan (2019)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF) as amended by Law 1121 of 2006 and Law 1621 of 2013; Law 1762 of 2015 (AML/CFT criminal framework, Criminal Code Art. 323); UIAF Resolution 164 of 2021 (mandatory UBO register for all Colombian legal entities), as amended by UIAF Resolution 234 of 2023; UIAF Circular 009 of 2022 (UBO reporting operational guidelines); inspection powers of DIAN and the Superintendence of Companies under Law 1258 of 2008 and the Commercial Code (Decree 410 of 1971).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (poder especial) for incorporation and initial filings, executed by each non-resident shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia acceded to the HCCH Apostille Convention, effective January 30, 2001)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport (copia autenticada del pasaporte) of each non-resident shareholder, director, and the appointed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent passport authority in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or notarial certification accepted by Colombian counsel for the corporate file)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Good Standing (certificado de existencia y representación, or foreign equivalent) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO statutory declaration (declaración jurada de beneficiario final) in UIAF prescribed format
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Legal representative executing on behalf of the S.A.S.; filed electronically with UIAF
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not applicable (domestic electronic filing; no notarization or apostille required)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-filing screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, legal representative, and every 5%+ UBO against: (i) U.S. OFAC SDN and Sectoral Sanctions lists including the 50% rule; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) UK HMT Consolidated List; (iv) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; and (v) Colombian UIAF risk list and national PEP registry. Enhanced due diligence (source of funds and source of wealth verification, corporate ownership chart, independent database verification) is mandatory for any PEP, for structures involving shell or opaque jurisdictions, or for shareholders resident in FATF high-risk jurisdictions. Screening results must be documented in the incorporation file and re-run within 24 hours before the Chamber of Commerce filing date.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sistema de Información Empresarial - RUES (www.rue.com.co) and the name reservation module ('Certificado de Homonimia') of the Cámara de Comercio having jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A registered name must be composed in Latin characters in Spanish. A foreign-language or cognate term is admissible only in Spanish transliteration if it is pronounceable in Spanish and does not create homonymy with an existing registration; however, a distinctive invented word (e.g., 'Soundscape') may be retained in its original spelling when it possesses clear distinctive character. The compulsory suffix 'S.A.S.' must appear as the final element of the full corporate name. The name must commence with a distinctive fantasy, patronymic, or geograph-division element that is not generic, descriptive, or confusingly similar to a registered trademark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Banca / Bank (reserved to financial entities; prior Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia authorization required)
Seguros / Reaseguros / Aseguradora (prior SFC authorization required)
Cooperativa / Fondo de Empleados (prior Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria approval required)
Fondo de Pensiones / Cesantías / Administradora de Fondos (prior SFC authorization required)
Fiduciaria / Fiducia / Sociedad Fiduciaria (prior SFC authorization required)
Bolsa de Valores / Corredor de Valores / Central de Valores (prior SFC authorization required)
Colombia / República / Nacional (prior authorization of the Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo - MinCIT required)
Ministerio / Presidencia / Superintendencia / Alcaldía / Gobernación (institutional tokens forbidden to private entities)
ONU / Banco de la República / SENA / ICBF / DIAN / Fiscalía (state-acronym tokens forbidden)
S.A. / LTDA / E.U. / S.C.A. (legal-form suffixes inconsistent with the S.A.S. regime are restricted)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The homonimia certificate expires if the incorporation document is not filed within 30 calendar days. A single renewal of an additional 30 days may be requested online through the chamber before expiry; after the second window lapses, a brand-new application must be submitted. On rejection, the applicant files a 'recurso de reposición' before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days under Law 1437 of 2011; if denied, a 'recurso de apelación' may be filed with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), which must resolve within 30 business days. In parallel, counsel should apply for 2-3 alternative name options so that clearance at filing is not blocked by a rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partial - the S.A.S. must maintain a physical address in Colombian territory for service of process, DIAN, and chamber notifications; P.O. boxes are not acceptable. A licensed virtual office or co-working address is permissible for this low-risk digital audio-licensing activity, provided the provider (i) supplies a verifiable physical street address located in the municipality where the chamber of jurisdiction operates, (ii) undertakes to receive official notifications and legal process, and (iii) the legal representative remains physically reachable during normal business hours for chamber verifications. The by-laws must state the precise 'domicilio social'; the virtual office address must appear in the RUES registration and be updated within 60 days of any change.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 12% probability of an unannounced verification visit by the Cámara de Comercio or DIAN within the first 12 months for a Low_Risk_Standard digital licensing company using a virtual office; probability increases to approximately 35% if electronic invoicing is not activated on time or if the registered address lacks any physical signage, mail reception capacity, or records for inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance ('Certificado de Homonimia') and RUES online consultation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / competent local chamber
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory chamber tariff (approx. COP 4,000; preliminary search free of charge via RUES)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. by-laws (minuta), incorporation file assembly, and AML/UBO onboarding documentation (local corporate counsel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard S.A.S. incorporation package including UBO report preparation (range USD 350-600)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign power of attorney, passport copies, and corporate good-standing certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority in the shareholder's country (e.g., U.S. State Department; U.K. FCDO; Spanish Ministry of Justice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fees plus courier and handling charges; prevailing market benchmark varies by issuing country (approx. USD 40-80 per document for competitive jurisdictions)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official sworn Spanish translation (traducción oficial) of apostilled documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian sworn translator (traductor oficial) registered with the Ministry of Justice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market tariff (approx. COP 60,000-90,000 per document page, equivalent to USD 15-25 per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce initial commercial registration and inscription fee (matrícula mercantil inicial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered-office jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff scale (derechos de inscripción) calculated progressively on declared share capital; assumed capital of COP 10,000,000 (approx. USD 2,500) yields approximately COP 450,000 (approx. USD 120)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial authentication of shareholders' and legal representative's signatures (autenticación de firmas) for private-document incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff (approx. COP 50,000-75,000 per signature set)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of accounting books (registro de libros de contabilidad) with the chamber after incorporation
Virtual office / registered address service (first 3 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (approx. USD 50-80 per month for co-working address, mail reception, and notification handling in Bogotá or Medellín)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), arts. 1-6, 17-22, 28-31; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 98-101 and 353 (supplementary); Decreto 1074 de 2015, arts. 133-139 (RUES electronic registration); Ley 2069 de 2020 (simplified start-up incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Registro Mercantil, operated through the RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) online portal; registration supervised by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (private incorporation deed and bylaws), filed electronically via the RUES platform and recorded in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S.; capital may be zero or nominal and must be fully subscribed, with payment required within two years unless the bylaws provide otherwise. No escrow account is required under Ley 1258 de 2008; contributions must be described in the incorporation deed and deposited in the company's bank account.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. At a virtual shareholders meeting duly convened and held with the sole shareholder representing the entire subscribed capital, the following resolutions were adopted unanimously: (1) Ratify the subscription of 1,000 ordinary shares, nominal value one thousand Colombian pesos each, fully paid in cash by the sole shareholder. (2) Adopt the premises at [registered address], Bogota D.C., Colombia, as the registered office. (3) Appoint [Representative Name] as Legal Representative and General Manager with the broadest powers under the bylaws, including bank account opening and licensing execution. (4) Instruct management to complete commercial registration, tax formalities, and operational licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá D.C. - Sede Electrónica RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic pre-registration on the RUES portal requesting one primary and two alternative corporate names. Pay the nominal name-search fee (approx. USD 1.50) and obtain the Certificado de Homonimia, valid for thirty calendar days. The certificate confirms that the proposed S.A.S. name does not collide with existing registered entities and must be attached to the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Passport or identity document of each shareholder
Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry reports similarity with an existing name, submit a new application with alternative names; a fresh application and fee are required within the remaining validity period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Private Incorporation Deed and Statutory Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Shareholders (private deed) or Notaría (public deed when real estate is contributed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos consistent with Ley 1258 de 2008. Include registered office, corporate purpose covering ISIC 5920 digital music licensing and commercial soundscape subscriptions, share capital, governance provisions, and first board resolutions. Execute with handwritten or certified electronic signatures. If real estate is contributed as capital, formalize before a Colombian notary.
required_dossiers: Valid government-issued IDs of all shareholders
RUT of shareholders resident in Colombia (if any)
Certificate of existence and legal representation for any corporate shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bylaws are defective, execute a formal amendment (aclaración y saneamiento) before the same notary or among all shareholders, preserving the original filing date and corporate continuity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration and Certificate of Existence (Matrícula Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil - Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá D.C.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed Documento Privado and the homonymy certificate to the RUES platform. Complete the single registration form (RUES), declare the subscribed and paid-in capital, pay the registration tariff calculated as 0.7% of subscribed capital subject to the legal floor, and obtain the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation confirming the company, its address, and appointed officers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration receives observations, correct and reply electronically within ten business days; if the time limit lapses, pay the reduced re-registration tariff and resubmit the corrected dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Sede Electrónica MUISCA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the DIAN portal, validate the Chamber of Commerce certificate against RUES, request the RUT for the S.A.S., and select the tax responsibilities applicable to royalty and audio-licensing income, including income tax, VAT where applicable, withholding responsibilities, and mandatory electronic invoicing. Obtain the printable RUT extract as legal proof of tax registration.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Identity document of the legal representative
RUT pre-registration form submitted via MUISCA
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of inconsistency between the tax registry and the commercial registry, rectify the RUES data first and then request RUT synchronization through the DIAN portal; allow up to two additional days for verification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Zoning Verification and Land-Use Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Planeación and Curaduría Urbana of Bogotá D.C.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the Certificado de Uso del Suelo for the registered office classified as digital-services or administrative office use. Attach the lease agreement and the Chamber of Commerce certificate. The certificate validates that the location permits virtual audio-content licensing business operations without physical manufacturing or industrial installations.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Floor plan of the office suite
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested land use is not permitted at that address, either change the registered legal address before the Chamber of Commerce or file an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) before the zoning authority within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration and Social Security Affiliation (PILA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Planilla Integrada de Liquidación de Aportes (PILA) and Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. as an employer in the Colombian social security system through the PILA portal and affiliate the legal representative to the EPS, ARL, and pension administrator. Assign occupational risk class I (administrative/digital services). No employees are required at this stage; mandatory affiliation applies upon the first hire.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If affiliation is rejected for data mismatches, update the RUT and re-run the PILA transaction; the ARL issues the occupational risk-class certificate within one additional business day.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no industrial or manufacturing establishment exists for this virtual digital audio licensing platform; commercial and municipal jurisdiction is exercised by the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá and the Secretaría Distrital de Planeación (zoning).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - no industrial operating permit; the relevant administrative clearances are the Certificado de Uso del Suelo (zoning certificate) and the Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety certificate) for the administrative office.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA); local jurisdiction shared with Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente, Bogotá D.C.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA or environmental license required; the activity is purely digital/administrative with no manufacturing processes, no hazardous waste generation, and no industrial wastewater discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater or VOC emissions. Compliance required with Decreto 1076 de 2015 (consolidated environmental regulations), Resolución 1512 de 2010 (e-waste disposal of IT equipment), and Resolución 0627 de 2006 (noise limits of 50-55 dB LAeq applicable to audio-testing rooms used for music preview).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado de Bomberos) from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bogotá under Ley 1575 de 2012 for the office occupancy; structural load inspection of the leased premises; installation of extinguishers and emergency signage; compliance as an administrative employer with the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) under Decreto 1072 de 2015 and Resolución 0312 de 2019, including workplace risk assessments and legal-representative medical clearances.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; electronic services portal: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Trámite Electrónico)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested S.A.S. must first be incorporated before the Cámara de Comercio and then register with DIAN in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). The RUT application is submitted via the MUISCA portal or through a duly appointed legal representative in Colombia, presenting: the articles of incorporation, the legal representative's ID, foreign shareholder proof, and the assigned NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). The NIT is the sole statutory tax identifier for corporate income tax, VAT, withholding, customs, and electronic invoicing. Registration must be completed before commencing any taxable business activity and is permanent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists. The S.A.S. is statutorily a taxable resident corporation subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income. The taxpayer may elect, upon meeting revenue and employment thresholds, the SIMPLE regime (option for small and medium entities) or claim certain territorial income exemptions (e.g., new companies in vulnerable zones). The Colombian anti-abuse hybrid mismatch provisions (Articles 105-106, Tax Statute; Decree 2129 of 2017) apply to prevent cross-border deduction/non-inclusion mismatches, but no entity-classification election for Colombian tax purposes is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold for S.A.S. or any other corporate entity making taxable supply in Colombia; all juridical persons are automatically VAT-registered responsible (régimen común) regardless of revenue. A 3,500 UVT annual threshold applies only to natural persons applying for the simplified VAT regime, which is unavailable to S.A.S. entities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: DIAN-mandated electronic invoicing (factura electrónica de venta) is mandatory for all VAT-registered S.A.S. taxpayers. Invoices must be transmitted in near real-time to DIAN via the authorized software provider's REST/API connectivity with MUISCA. DIAN performs automatic validation and, upon success, returns a 'CUDE' (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or digital stamp mandatory to be printed or embedded in the XML and QR code. Invoices without valid DIAN validation are legally ineffective for tax deduction and VAT crediting. Corrective and equivalent documents follow the same clearance protocol.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated VAT applies under Article 481 of the Colombian Tax Statute to (i) tangible goods physically exported out of Colombian customs territory, and (ii) services rendered exclusively to non-domiciled persons or to goods/machinery destined entirely abroad, provided the services are not used in Colombia. Royalty-free stock music and audio licensing supplied to non-Colombian customers via digital platforms qualifies as an electronic export of services if the license is exclusively for use abroad, the recipient has no Colombian domicile, and the right/benefit does not create a local exploitation event. The taxpayer must maintain verifiable proof that the digital licensing income is not subject to anti-abuse re-characterization as a license used in Colombia.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) or Form 610 electronic export service declaration filed through MUISCA
Bill of Lading, AWB, or digital logistics receipt evidencing exit for goods; for services, signed license agreement and delivery records via digital platform
Commercial invoice (Factura de Venta a Exportación) with zero-rated IVA, or electronic export invoice
Inward Remittance Certificate (Reintegro de Divisas) or foreign exchange settlement certificate when the export value exceeds USD 10,000 equivalent
Certification of non-domicile/foreign residency of the buyer or licensee (DIAN Form 510 / affidavit)
Evidence of payment receipt in currency other than Colombian pesos, plus screenshot/export ledger from the digital marketplace
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retroactively disallow zero-rating and assess the unpaid 19% VAT plus interest if the documentation bundle is incomplete, contradictory, or does not prove effective and exclusive foreign use. Penalties for inaccurate or fraudulent export claims range from 100% to 200% of the VAT amount at issue, and fraudulent claims may trigger criminal tax-fraud liability under Law 1762/2017, including imprisonment. Repeated audit failures may lead to suspension of electronic invoicing authorization and enhanced scrutiny of all subsequent claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) in conjunction with the Comisión Intersectorial de Seguimiento del Régimen de Cambios Internacionales; operational enforcement is exercised through authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMC) and the national tax/customs authority DIAN for ex-post verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian Peso (COP) is freely convertible for current-account operations, including international licensing royalties and SaaS-like audio distribution. Capital-account operations, such as inbound equity injections, require prior registration with Banco de la República through an IMC. Profit remittances from an S.A.S. are lawful once the corporate income tax return is filed and the foreign investment has been properly registered; dividends may be transferred abroad in foreign currency without mandatory conversion, but the corresponding foreign-exchange declaration must be submitted. No prior administrative license is required for the establishment or operation of a digital music licensing platform; the primary hurdles are documentary: preservation of the investment registration certificate (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales), proof of tax standing, and compliance with the sub-tenor reporting rules for service export collections.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For cross-border sales of royalty-free licensed music (ISIC 5920), the exporter S.A.S. must ensure that all export-service proceeds are repatriated and economically channeled through an IMC within six months from the date of service rendering, or from the date of invoice if earlier. The regime does not force the mandatory conversion of foreign currency into COP; the proceeds may be held in a foreign-currency deposit account or a compensation account abroad, but the payment must be evidenced through the local foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio) if settled via an IMC. For receipts collected by foreign payment aggregators (e.g., Stripe, PayPal), the S.A.S. must initiate an MT103 or direct account-to-account transfer to the local bank within that statutory term; a monthly reconciliation is recommended to support the 6020 service-purpose code used on the exchange declaration.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with strict regulatory caveats. Offshore digital EMIs (including Payoneer, Wise Business, Airwallex) are not authorized as IMCs in Colombia and cannot legally offer local COP-denominated clearing accounts. They can only act as non-regulated collection aggregators, and the Colombian S.A.S. must subsequently repatriate net proceeds to an authorized local bank through an inbound SWIFT or ACI debit transfer. The platform target rails (Stripe, PayPal) are acceptable for payment acceptance, but their direct integration to a Colombian bank may expose the entity to foreign-exchange channeling violations if monthly cross-border transactions are not formalized through an IMC declaration. For this business model, a hybrid solution is recommended: use Stripe/PayPal for global collection, then weekly batch transfers to the local Bancolombia or Banco de Bogotá account under service purpose code 6020.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the legal representative is not legally mandatory, but a face-to-face or high-integrity video interview is required by the Compliance Officer at tier-1 banks when opening an S.A.S. bank account. The legal representative and any ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must supply original notarized incorporation documents (certificado de existencia y representación legal), RUT, valid passports or government-issued IDs, proof of address, a corporate address in Colombia, and evidence of the foreign investment registration. Remote onboarding is available only for non-resident shareholders with a local power of attorney or for pre-approved Fintech-linked business accounts; for the standard S.A.S., a local attorney-in-fact with a notarized power of attorney (poder especial) is accepted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity inbound micro-royalty payments from internet-based licensees, exceeding 500 individual transactions per month, triggering automated AML monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete digital licensing agreement library, machine-readable sales ledger from the platform, country-of-origin payer metadata, a documented AML compliance manual aligned with Circular Básica Jurídica (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia), and periodic external audit reports demonstrating transaction monitoring. Include a written explanation of the platform-level KYC performed by Stripe/PayPal.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: A single B2B licensee remitting more than USD 10,000 per month, generating perceived concentration risk in a low-risk digital content industry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal commercial contract with the licensee, invoices issued by the S.A.S., bank statements showing consistent and periodic receipt pattern, a declaration of source of funds (Formato de Declaración de Origen de Fondos), and an updated UBO/OFSAC sanctions screening certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Routing settlement via an offshore EMI before a local bank transfer, raising questions on the true counterparty and underlying service export.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated reconciliation report mapping every EMI payout to its corresponding Stripe/PayPal transaction reference, the EMI's compliance statement, and an affidavit from the legal representative that no unauthorized third-party payment has been included. Keep a dated record of the platform sales order metadata for three years.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All shareholder capital contributions must be wired to the S.A.S.'s local account through an authorized IMC, using the foreign investment declaration model and the payment reference 'Aporte de Capital – Inversión Extranjera Directa'. The remittance must include the corporate bank details and the certificate of investment registration issued by Banco de la República (Form 6 – Registro de Inversiones Internacionales). The transaction must be reported by the IMC via the standard electronic system within one business day. If the contribution is made in-kind (e.g., upstream IP license), the valuation report and the sworn declaration are required at the moment of capital election and must be maintained for subsequent profit-repatriation clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For recurring royalty payments abroad (e.g., partnering composer collectives, distribution platforms) the preferred clearing rail is an SWIFT MT103 executed through an IMC under service purpose code 6020, accompanied by a digital copy of the commercial invoice and the underlying license agreement. Commercial letters of credit are unsuitable for intangible audio licensing and are not recommended. Disbursements must be registered via the monthly foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio por Servicios) no later than 30 calendar days after settlement. To support treasury forecasting, settle outbound wires in a single weekly batch to reduce bank fees and enhance audit traceability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD OTC forward contracts (Forwards a medida) executed exclusively through an authorized IMC, with underlying exposure evidenced by existing or projected royalty inflows and a maturity capped at 12 months.

Plain-vanilla foreign-currency options (European-style, call/put on USD/COP) contracted with a local bank under an ISDA or Colombian Banco de la República Master Agreement, solely for hedge accounting of recorded receivables.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CIRS) between COP and USD for term-debt denominated, subject to the IMC's product-eligibility rules and the local tax treatment of derivative contracts; no speculative NDF positions are permitted for Colombian-resident entities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil – Annual renewal of the commercial registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce of the registered seat; for Bogotá: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January – 31 March each year (commercial registry renewal for the current year; no extensions).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal ≥1 April triggers a surcharge on the chamber tariff, default status in the registry, bar to obtain current certificates/RUT updates and foreign trade authorizations; persistent non-renewal (two consecutive years) leads to cancellation of the registration (administrative strike-off) and SIC fines up to 200 SMLMV.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros – Annual financial statements deposit (certified statements, notes, management report and revisor fiscal opinion if any)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (same chamber; statements simultaneously available for DIAN via the registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval by 31 March; deposit with the Chamber within one month after approval, i.e., no later than 30 April following the 31 December fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit: fine imposed by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio up to 200 SMLMV (COP ~284.7M / USD ~69K in 2025); the following year's renewal is blocked (statements are a renewal prerequisite), registry is marked non-compliant and DIAN may reject tax loss/carry-forward positions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios – Annual corporate income tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, April–May of the following fiscal year; exact date assigned by the last two digits of the NIT under DIAN's annual calendar (2024 tax year: 8 April – 21 May 2025).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty: 1% of tax payable per month or fraction, capped at 100% of tax; if no tax payable, 1% of gross income per month capped at 5% of gross income (ET Art. 641), plus default interest; failure to file after DIAN notice: minimum penalty and loss of loss carry-forwards/credits, and potential to be flagged in the 'declarantes omisos' list.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Reporte Anual de Beneficiarios Finales – annual UBO confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 December (per DIAN's RBF calendar for recent cycles); qualifying ownership changes must be reported within 15 business days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non/incorrect filing: DIAN fine under ET Art. 651 up to 10,000 SMLMV (COP ~14.2B / USD ~3.4M in 2025), RUT recalcitrance and closure of tax benefits; the legal representative is personally sanctioned.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory revisor fiscal for a Colombian S.A.S. (Ley 222/1995 Art. 203; Ley 1258/2008) if at the preceding 31-Dec balance-sheet date it has: (i) total assets > 5,000 SMLMV (COP ~7.12B / USD ~1.72M for 2025); OR (ii) gross income > 3,000 SMLMV (COP ~4.27B / USD ~1.03M); OR (iii) more than 200 workers. Also mandatory if the S.A.S. is a subordinated entity of a supervised financial/insurance group. Below thresholds, an S.A.S. may dispense with the revisor fiscal and file certified (non-dictamen) statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS framework as adopted in Colombia by Decree 2420/2015 (as amended): Grupo 1 – full IFRS (large/public-interest); Grupo 2 – IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para PYMES) for medium SMEs; Grupo 3 – simplified micro-enterprise framework (Decree 2706/2012) for companies with ≤10 employees and total assets ≤500 SMLMV (excluding main residence). The stock-music licensing S.A.S. is presumed Grupo 2 (NIIF para PYMES) unless it meets micro thresholds. Statements must be prepared/expressed in COP with USD-revenue translation per IAS 21; IFRS 15 governs subscription/revenue recognition.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Colombian legal entity must maintain and annually confirm its UBO file in DIAN's RBF (Res. 164/2021 mod. Res. 91/2022): the legal representative certifies the UBO data each year by 31 December (recent cycles) through DIAN's portal; any share transfer causing addition/removal of direct/indirect ownership ≥5% or a control change must be reported within 15 business days. For the S.A.S., share transfers are perfected toward the company upon endorsement in the share register; non-resident transferors are subject to Colombian capital-gains withholding (10% on sales of shares not listed on a Colombian stock exchange, per current treaty/ET rules).
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Registro de Accionistas (Register of Members) – mandatory under Ley 1258/2008, Art. 40
Libro de Actas de la Asamblea de Accionistas (Shareholders' Meeting Minute Book) – mandatory
Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva (Board of Directors' Minute Book) – required only if a board was incorporated
Libros de Contabilidad (Libro Diario and Libro Mayor) – mandatory; each book must be pre-registered at the Chamber of Commerce before first use

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for below-threshold S.A.S. (no statutory audit) plus USD 700–1,500 for CPA-certified statement preparation; USD 1,500–4,000 if a revisor fiscal audit becomes mandatory

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general preferential rate. Targeted incentives: 25% income tax credit for qualified Science, Technology and Innovation (CTeI) investments; 200% payroll deduction for employees under the Programa Jóvenes; the 'Economía Naranja' 7-year income tax exemption was repealed for new beneficiaries effective FY2023. Low-revenue SAS may opt for the SIMPLE consolidated regime (income <= 80,000 UVT, approx. COP 3.8 billion) which substitutes CIT, VAT and industry-and-commerce tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas; mandatory electronic filing through the DIAN MUISCA portal. Transfer-pricing users must also file Form 120 (Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia) and Form 121/122 documentation components on the same schedule.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due between mid-April and late-May of the year following the fiscal year-end, staggered by the last two digits of the NIT (e.g., FY2024 returns: approximately April 22 to May 21, 2025, per DIAN Resolution). Fiscal year is the calendar year unless a special period is granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: DANE CIUU Rev. 4 A.C. economic activity code; for stock music licensing enter 5920 (sound recording and music publishing).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned SAS must register the same code with DIAN upon NIT activation; an incorrect code triggers automatic screening for foreign income and withholding mismatches.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross subscription, per-download and sync-licensing fees from the royalty-free stock music catalog, including Stripe/PayPal settlements before platform commission deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide gross receipts of the Colombian entity; income derived by the SAS is Colombian-source when the payer uses the license in Colombia or the principal payment flows through a Colombian settlement account.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Contractual chargebacks, subscriber refunds and payment-rail disputes actually granted and evidenced by platform reports.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only documented refunds may reduce gross income; PayPal/Stripe reversal fees are deductible expenses, not reductions of income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Royalty splits paid to independent artists and sample owners, direct hosting and streaming delivery costs, and license acquisition costs for the catalog.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to foreign artists/labels must satisfy documentary and WHT rules (33% royalty withholding absent a DTA); undocumented cost-sharing with a related foreign parent will be challenged under transfer-pricing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing (Google Ads/SEM), software hosting, legal and audit fees, depreciation of computer equipment and amortization of intangible software platforms.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border invoices for digital advertising and technical services are subject to 15% WHT where the service qualifies as technical, or 33% where the economic use of the service occurs in Colombia; deductibility requires WHT withholding certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward from prior years, limited to the 12-year carryforward period and to the recomputation caps set by Law 2277/2022.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses sustained by the Colombian SAS under Colombian GAAP/tax-basis are eligible; foreign-parent losses cannot be attributed to the SAS.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after exempt-income exclusions and the presumptive-income floor (renta presuntiva) of 3% of net equity; must respect the 15% minimum effective taxation rule for FY2024 onward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A capital-thin SAS with no employees or physical substance cannot rely on the exempt-income exclusion; the 35% rate applies to the whole net taxable base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax due = net taxable income x 35%, less CTeI credits, advance payments (anticipos), and withholding tax credits evidenced by Certificates Form 140/141.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not reported in Box 96; the company must separately register dividend distributions and withhold 10% on the shareholder's behalf via Form 110 and the dividend-payment module.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing (Article 641 E.T.): 5% of the tax payable per month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax; when no tax is payable, a UVT-based minimum is automatically imposed by MUISCA. Accuracy penalty (Article 648 E.T.): 100% of the understated tax for misstatements; late-payment interest accrues at the average bank lending rate plus 7%. Incorrect transfer-pricing filing (Form 120) triggers a penalty of 5% of the value of the cross-border transactions under Articles 260-9/1043 E.T.
